short: First hybrid CTC/attention AVSR in the ledger (0 of 32 earlier), but no CTC- or attention-only run, LRW and LibriSpeech under the LRS2-only claim, one run: all standard.
position: M06 changed, standard: no earlier sentence-level AVSR study in the ledger trains a hybrid CTC/attention objective, and the objective later reached 1.5% LRS2 AVSR WER, but the paper never runs CTC-only or attention-only on LRS2, and the concurrent GRID study found a jointly trained variant worse than a single-loss cascade. M07 and M12 incidental, standard: an RNN-LM on LibriSpeech text with no LM-free result, and a noise sweep over unseen noise types from one run. The 'trained only on LRS2' comparison omits the LRW front-end pre-training and the LibriSpeech LM text.
